page_annotations: Image-reviewed finding: the principal target page (fol. [343b], verso following fol. 343) is blank. The overview and all six native tiles were reviewed. These cover the top edge, the body, the bottom edge, the left margin column, the gutter and the strip beyond it. Only printed horizontal rulings, the vertical margin rule (about x≈780–840) and scattered paper specks and fibres are visible. No ink or pencil writing, ticks, numbers or other marks were identified.
No folio number is visible. The supplied label 'fol. [343b]' is preserved as metadata only.

A narrow strip of the facing page (fol. 344) is visible beyond the gutter at the right, about x≈3060–3508. It is ruled and shows no writing in the visible portion. It is excluded from the target page.
Stacked page edges are visible at the left edge. This is a physical feature, not text.
The provisional inventory listed no blocks, so no block dispositions are required. No blocks were added.
unresolved_relationships: Faint diagonal fibre, texture or offset marks appear in the upper body, about y≈500–1500, and in a few places lower down. At native scale they appear to be paper texture rather than writing, but very faint pencil cannot be wholly excluded.

coverage.finding: The source image shows a ruled strip beyond the gutter and fold, at about x≈3060–3508. The overview places the fold at about x≈1240 of 1403, which is about x≈3100 native. Native tiles 2 and 6 show no ink or pencil in this strip. The adjacent overview of fol. 344 is consistent with this: its left (inner) portion is ruled and blank. The strip is a facing-page fragment, not a target record. The candidate page annotation records this correctly.

The page carries printed horizontal rulings and a vertical margin rule. The rule runs from about x≈780 at the top to about x≈840 at the bottom, slanting slightly. Scattered dark specks and short fibres are also present, for example near x≈2430, y≈990 and x≈3180, y≈3450. None of these forms a letter, numeral, tick or ditto mark. The candidate page annotations record them as physical or printed features.
Stacked page edges show along the left edge at about x≈290–350. There is a small notch near y≈1060. These are not text, and the candidate annotation records them.

unresolved.issue: Very faint greyish diagonal streaks appear in the upper body, mainly at about y≈500–1500, with isolated short diagonal strokes lower down. Examples are near x≈2420–2450, y≈1530–1560 and x≈2180, y≈3800. At native scale they look like paper fibre, texture or offset from a facing page rather than writing. Very faint pencil cannot be wholly excluded at this image contrast.
unresolved.next_check: Inspect the upper body under raking light or with enhanced contrast. Only record writing if letterforms become discernible.

review.boundary_review: The principal target extends from the stacked left edge at about x≈290 to the gutter and fold at about x≈3060–3120, and from about y≈305 to about y≈4880. [343b]' is kept as metadata only. Nothing from the preceding page (fol. 343, Panjabi contd., with entries ending at e.251) carries over onto this page. No ditto or continuation relationships can be established because the page contains no writing.

region_review.middle: The middle body shows only rulings, faint fibre and texture streaks, and isolated specks. No ink or pencil text is visible.
region_review.bottom: The bottom of the page, at about y≈4300–4880, shows rulings and a few specks, for example near x≈2980, y≈4800. There is no bottom note.
region_review.left_margin: The margin column between the stacked edges and the vertical rule at about x≈780–840 is empty apart from rulings and specks. There is no shelfmark.
region_review.right_margin: The right side of the target near the gutter is blank. The facing-page strip beyond the fold is ruled and blank, and is excluded from the target.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions, ticks, arrows or cancellations were seen between the rulings.
